# scipy.special

Runnable examples from `examples/special/` (executed on both backends by the gate).

## combinatorics

Combinatorics with the gamma family. Both backends.
SciPy: scipy.special.comb(n, k); scipy.special.gammaln(x)

comb is the binomial coefficient; gammaln(n+1) = log(n!), the numerically safe way to work
with factorials that would otherwise overflow.

## logistic-and-erf

Two workhorse special functions: the logistic sigmoid and the error function. Both backends.
SciPy: scipy.special.expit(x); scipy.special.erf(x)

expit(x) = 1 / (1 + e^-x) is the logistic link used in classification; erf underlies the
normal CDF. Scalars return a float; arrays return an NDArray.
